question: Within how many days must business books of accounts and receipts be registered with the City Treasurer, and what is the late fine?
answer: Within fifteen (15) working days from the time of filing the application for new or renewal of business permit, business books of accounts and receipts must be registered with the City Treasurer. If not done so, an administrative fine of Five Thousand Pesos (P 5,000.00) will be imposed. [S1]

ground_truth: The charter Annex 9 states that failure to register books of accounts, books of records, official receipts, cash sales, cash invoices, delivery receipts and other collection receipts within fifteen (15) working days from filing a new or renewal business-permit application incurs an administrative fine of PHP5,000.
